listing.name: Combat Docking Module v0.0.7
listing.summary: I'm reviving this mod with permission from the original creator
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod that allows ships to dock with carriers for repair and replenishment when damaged or out of ammo.

description:
Download here

Original Forum Link

Requires LazyLib

I'm reviving this mod with permission from the original creator

This mod adds a hullmod that allows you to be able to dock with any carrier larger than a frigate. Once you lose 20% of your hull HP, fall below 40% CR, or run out of ammunition, you can turn on autopilot and your ship will navigate to its assigned carrier and land to repair and replenish.

v0.0.7 - Added support for a few mods, details below

SpoilerAdded compatibility for PASGM, ArmaA, Battlefleets of the Gothic Sector, Birds Collection of Trinkets and Rarities, Brighton Federation, BigBeans Ship Compilation, Bultach Coalition, Carters Freetraders, Caymons Ship Pack, Diable Avionics, Domain Explorarium Expansion, Domain Phase Lab, Domain Reformed, ED Shipyards, Emergent Threats+IX Battlegroup, Everybody Loves KoC, Gensoukyou Manufacture, Goathead Aviation Bureau, Grytpype and Moriartys Defense Authority, Hazard Mining Incorporated+Supervillains,  Hiver Swarm, Industrial Evolution, Interstellar Imperium, Iron Shell, Junkyard Dogs, Keruvim Shipyards, LOST_SECTOR, Machina Void Shipyards, Mayasuran Navy, Metelson, Missile Ship Overhaul, Musashi Manufactorum, Neoteric Advent, Ness' Ship and Weapon Pack, Nexerelin, Orbital Manipulation & Maintenance, Persean Chronicles, PMMM, all PRV submods, Random Assortment of Things, Random Weapon Collection, Roider Union, RotcesRats, Salvage Ship Expansion, San Iris, SCAV-CO Shipworks, Scy Nation, Secrets of the Frontier, Ship & Weapon Pack, ArmaA, Stopgap Measures, Support Ship Pack, Tahlan Shipworks, The Exalted, The Knights of Ludd, Tri-Tach Special Circumstances, Underworld, United Aurora Federation, VIC, Volantian Reclamation Initiative, and Xhan Empire.[close]

Known issues:

-Drift if the landing happens too fast.

-Fighter Collision class break some weapons that does not target fighters.

-Refit time is very short if HP is full. (Feature?)

-

Unknown result if the carrier retreats with the ship landed inside. Coded for, but untested edge case.

-ANY docked ship will explode if carrier retreats with ship inside

-AI pilot doesn't initialize if carrier doesn't have an LPC equipped. 06/18/2021

All credit goes to Harpuea and all code is theirs
